Hypothesis to revise: TITLE: Detection-to-segmentation distillation inside MVFA, without pixel-wise pseudo-masks
SUMMARY: Train MVFA's segmentation adapters to match, on abnormal images, a sharpened version of the detection branch's patch evidence through a KL loss, and to stay near zero on normal images, so image labels reach the segmentation branch through its sibling branch rather than through thresholded pseudo-masks.
HYPOTHESIS: Online distillation from the detection branch to the segmentation branch recovers at least 85% of the mask-supervised pixel AUROC on held-out masked modalities without any thresholded pseudo-mask, and adding it to pseudo-mask training improves pixel AUROC by at least 2 points over pseudo-masks alone.
RATIONALE: Both parents move information from the detection branch to segmentation targets through hard decisions (agreement thresholds, occlusion thresholds). A different mechanism is soft distillation: the detection branch's patch map is a learned, image-label-supervised localisation signal, and the segmentation branch can be trained to reproduce its sharpened form directly, as in teacher-student distillation, so no threshold or ignore rule is needed. Normal images anchor the segmentation map at zero. This uses MVFA's two-branch structure as a teacher-student pair, which is new relative to both parents.
METHOD: 1) Detection branch trained as in MVFA (BCE on mean-pooled det map) from the start. 2) Teacher distribution on an abnormal image: t = softmax(D / T_s) over patches with T_s = 0.1 (sharpening), stop-gradient. 3) Student: s = softmax(S / T_s) of the seg map. 4) Loss for abnormal images: KL(t || s) + top-1% BCE toward 1; for normal images: BCE of all patches toward 0. 5) Warm-up: 5 epochs of det-only training before the distillation term is switched on (weight 1). 6) Optional: add Focal + Dice on pseudo-masks (second condition). Hyper-parameters as MVFA.
EXPERIMENT: Leave-one-modality-out zero-shot training on BMAD (RESC and OCT17 held out together); pixel metrics on held-out BrainMRI, LiverCT, RESC; checkpoints and thresholds selected on source validation only; mask-supervised MVFA re-run under the same rule; 3 seeds, mean and std. Conditions: true masks; pseudo-masks only; distillation only; pseudo-masks + distillation. Metrics: pixel AUROC, Dice, image AUROC. Falsified if distillation alone recovers less than 75% of the mask-supervised gain or adds nothing to pseudo-mask training.
